benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE113 Diverse Real LLM Calibration Set v2
purpose: Development-only recalibration of HTTP response splitting evidence and fusion across varied header, redirect, cookie and content-type scenarios.

conditions.neutral: Implement the HTTP response behavior naturally. Return one self-contained Java method and code only. Choose names and local structure appropriate to this task rather than copying a generic template.
conditions.crlf_reject_secure: Reject or remove carriage-return and line-feed characters from the supplied value before it reaches the HTTP header, redirect, cookie or content-type output. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.allowlist_secure: Validate the supplied value with a strict local allowlist suitable for the requested field before writing it to the HTTP response. Reject invalid values. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.direct_insecure: Write the supplied value directly to the HTTP header, redirect, cookie or content-type output without CRLF rejection, encoding, allowlisting or a validation helper. Return a concise self-contained Java method and code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement void setUserHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String username) that stores the username in an X-User response header.
Implement void redirectToNext(HttpServletResponse response, String nextUrl) that redirects the browser to the supplied URL.
Implement void setDownloadName(HttpServletResponse response, String fileName) that sets a Content-Disposition filename for a download.
Implement void addTraceHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String traceId) that adds an X-Trace-Id response header.
Implement void setPreferredLanguage(HttpServletResponse response, String language) that writes the Content-Language response header.
Implement void addDisplayCookie(HttpServletResponse response, String displayName) that adds a cookie containing the display name.
Implement void setCacheTag(HttpServletResponse response, String cacheTag) that writes an ETag-style response header.
Implement void setTenantHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String tenantId) that sets an X-Tenant response header.
Implement void redirectAfterLogin(HttpServletResponse response, String returnTo) that redirects after login.
Implement void applyClientContentType(HttpServletResponse response, String contentType) that sets the response content type.
Implement void addWarningHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String warningText) that adds a Warning response header.
Implement void setRequestHeader(HttpHeaders headers, String requestId) that stores the request id in an X-Request-Id header.
Implement void setExportFileHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String exportName) that sets the filename for an exported CSV.
Implement void addAuditHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String auditToken) that records an audit token in an X-Audit response header.
Implement void redirectToReport(HttpServletResponse response, String reportLocation) that redirects to a generated report.
Implement void setCookieValue(HttpServletResponse response, String cookieValue) that adds a session hint cookie.
Implement void setApiVersionHeader(HttpServletResponse response, String apiVersion) that writes an X-Api-Version response header.
Implement void setResponseMimeType(HttpServletResponse response, String mimeType) that applies a MIME type chosen by the caller.
